name: Clontarf Coast and Malahide Lanes
description: Out along the Clontarf and Dollymount seafront to Sutton, then the coast road through Portmarnock to Malahide. Home on the quiet lanes through Kinsealy and Donaghmede, flat all the way.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Clontarf to Donabate
description: The coast road to Malahide, then the Lissenhall lanes behind Swords out to Donabate. Back through Kinsealy and Raheny on flat, steady north Dublin roads.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Clontarf to the Naul Hills
description: The coast to Malahide, then north through Ballyboughal and up the lanes under Knockbrack to the Naul. Home by Oldtown, Rowlestown and Kinsealy on quiet north county roads.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Howth Head and the North Lanes
description: Straight up from the harbour to the Summit and down Carrickbrack Road to Sutton. Then the coast road to Malahide and home through Kinsealy, Raheny and the Howth Road.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Malahide, Donabate and Ballyboughal
description: Round the estuary to Donabate and out towards Portrane, then west over the M1 to the lanes around Ballyboughal. Back past Rowlestown and the west side of Swords to Malahide.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Skerries, Rush and the Balrothery Lanes
description: The coast road to Rush, inland through Lusk and out to the rolling lanes west of the M1. Home through Balrothery and Balbriggan and back along the coast.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: The Naul Hills
description: Knockbrack and Hollywood straight from the village, then Ballyboughal, Garristown Hill and Ardcath. Short, sharp north Dublin and Meath hills on empty lanes.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Killakee, Pine Forest and Glencullen
description: Along Tibradden Road past the foot of Kilmashogue, up Stocking Lane to Killakee and across the Pine Forest Road to Glencullen. Down to Enniskerry and home over the Scalp and Stepaside.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Rathfarnham to the Sally Gap and Laragh
description: Killakee and the Military Road over Glencree to the Sally Gap, then down Glenmacnass to Laragh. Back through Annamoe, Roundwood and Calary to Enniskerry and home.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Rathfarnham to the Wicklow Gap
description: Enniskerry, Glencree and the Sally Gap, down Glenmacnass to Laragh, then Glendalough and over the Wicklow Gap. Home by the Blessington lakes, Kilbride and Ballinascorney.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Enniskerry, Calary and Roundwood
description: Over Calary bog on the R755 to Roundwood and a lap of the Vartry reservoir. Back up past Calary and over the Old Long Hill to Enniskerry.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Enniskerry to Glendalough
description: Calary, Roundwood and the Vartry, then Annamoe and Laragh for the run into Glendalough. Home over the Sally Gap and down past Glencree to Enniskerry.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Bray Coast and the Vartry
description: Over Windgates to Greystones and Kilcoole, then up from Newtownmountkennedy to Roundwood and round the Vartry reservoir. Home over the Old Long Hill to Enniskerry and back to the seafront.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Greystones, Kilmurry and Calary
description: Kilcoole and Newtownmountkennedy, then the Kilmurry climb and a lap of the Vartry at Roundwood. Back over Calary and Kilmacanogue to Greystones.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Lucan and the Kildare Lanes
description: West through Leixlip and Moyglare to Kilcock, then south on quiet lanes by Rathcoffey to Clane. Home through Straffan and Celbridge; flat and fast on narrow roads.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.

name: Kilcullen and the Blessington Lakes
description: East to Ballymore Eustace and round the Blessington lakes by Valleymount, Ballyknockan and Lacken. Back through the lanes west of Blessington to Kilcullen.

road_report.summary: Meets the LOOPS Road Standard: no main roads, nothing over 80 km/h, 100% paved.
